sloka: बलैः समग्रैर्यदि मां हत्वा रावणमाहवे ।विजयी स्वां पुरीं रामो नयेत्तत् स्याद्यशस्करम् ।। ५.६८.१२ ।।।।
transliteration: balaiḥ samagrairyadi māṁ hatvā rāvaṇamāhave ।vijayī svāṁ purīṁ rāmo nayettat syādyaśaskaram ।। 5.68.12 ।।।।

translations.english: 'When Rama slays Ravana and his entire army and takes me to his city after becoming victorious it will add glory to him.
